tokens.comment: curve leaves at end of coi

tokens.name: CFCLSC
tokens.comment: curve enters at start of coi

tokens.name: CHOPLC
tokens.comment: check for loop consistency of faces

tokens.name: CHOPNO
tokens.comment: no options, force all appropriate checks to the geometry

tokens.name: CHOPPV
tokens.comment: force self-intersection tests on Pre-V5 b-geometry

tokens.name: CHOPSH
tokens.comment: check for inside-out or inconsistent shells

tokens.name: CODCVP
tokens.comment: Segment is coincident with a viewport boundary

tokens.name: CODESF
tokens.comment: Edge is coincident with sharp mfins

tokens.name: CODIGN
tokens.comment: Edge lies on the boundary of an ignorable feature

tokens.name: CODIJK
tokens.comment: SDF values are output with index i varying fastest

tokens.name: CODINS
tokens.comment: Edge is internal, coincides with silhouette

tokens.name: CODINU
tokens.comment: Not known whether edge is internal

tokens.name: CODISH
tokens.comment: Line segment is invisible (hidden by its own body occ)

tokens.name: CODKJI
tokens.comment: SDF values are output with index k varying fastest

tokens.name: CODLOW
tokens.comment: SDF is evaluated at (low,low,low) corner of each voxel

tokens.name: CODMID
tokens.comment: SDF is evaluated at centre of each voxel

tokens.name: CODNES
tokens.comment: Edge is not coincident with sharp mfins
